sheet.order: row-major, top-left first (Aseprite frame n = cell n-1)
sheet.png: RGBA or indexed PNG, no partial alpha (alpha < 128 = empty, >= 128 = solid)

spec.pivot: the pixel CORNER at (16,16) inside each cell, i.e. the point shared by pixels (15..16, 15..16); guides mark those 4 pixels red

eye.draw: the character's LEFT eye as you see it on screen (right side of the face): nose side = cell LEFT, outer corner = cell RIGHT; the right eye is the mirror image
eye.scale: race eye size multiplies the pixel size about the pivot (Great Elf x1.12)

brow.draw: same side and mirroring as the eye (nose side = cell left)

mouth.draw: the whole mouth as seen from the front, NOT mirrored; the face midline is the line between pixel columns 15 and 16

spec.anchors_space: bald4 glTF bind pose, metres: x = character left, y = up, z = front; features are projected straight back (-z) onto the head

roles.iris0/1/2: replaced by the 3-stop iris ramp (light / mid / dark)
roles.skin0/1/2: replaced by the current race skin tone x 1.0 / 0.85 / 0.70 (eyelids, creases, lip shading)
roles.brow0/1/2: replaced by the brow colour x 1.15 / 1.0 / 0.72
roles.guide: never drawn: the page drops these pixels and warns

aseprite.export: File > Export Sprite Sheet: Sheet type By Rows, Constraints Fixed # of Columns = 4, Layers Visible layers (Merge), Frames All frames, Borders/Padding 0, Trim off -> face_sheet.png 128x128
